body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> iGo presented its laptop charger equipped with iGo Green technology at the pre-press event '2009 CES Unveiled', which uses 80% less standby power than standard power products.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
